# FB Video Downloaders — llms.txt

> FB Video Downloaders is a free browser-based tool for downloading public Facebook videos and Reels in HD or SD quality. No login required. No app installation needed. Works on Android, iPhone, and desktop browsers.

## About

FB Video Downloaders helps users save publicly accessible Facebook videos, Reels, and short clips directly from their browser. The tool processes the video link and provides HD and SD download options in MP4 format. It does not store downloaded videos on its servers.

- Free to use — no registration or subscription
- Supports public Facebook videos, Reels, and timeline clips
- HD and SD quality options available
- Works on Android, iPhone, tablet, and desktop (Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox)
- No Facebook login required
- Videos saved directly to user's device

## How to Use FB Video Downloaders

1. Open the public Facebook video or Reel in your browser
2. Copy the video URL from the address bar
3. Paste the URL into the downloader field at fbvideodownloaders.com
4. Click "Analyze Link" to fetch download options
5. Choose HD (high definition) or SD (standard quality)
6. Click Download — the video saves directly to your device

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How do I download a Facebook video for free?**
Copy the public Facebook video URL, paste it into FB Video Downloaders, and click Download. No login or app required.

**Can I download Facebook Reels?**
Yes. Copy any public Reel link, paste it into the field, and choose your preferred quality.

**What formats are available?**
FB Video Downloaders provides MP4 downloads in HD and SD quality depending on the original video quality on Facebook.

**Is it safe to use?**
Yes. FB Video Downloaders does not require your Facebook login or personal data. Videos go directly to your device — nothing is stored on our servers.

**Does it work on mobile?**
Yes. The tool works in Chrome, Safari, and other mobile browsers on Android and iPhone.
